name: Rune-Inscribed Parchment
summary: At the Valley of Trials, a rune-marked summons calls new shamans to Shikrik. Gornek delivers the parchment, which begins their formal training in communion with spirits and elements.

sections.title: A Summons from the Spirits
sections.body: After proving their survival skills against local wildlife, new orc shamans receive a rune-inscribed parchment from Gornek, overseer of the Valley of Trials. Its mystical writing comes from Shikrik, the valley's shaman trainer, who asks to meet the newly arrived initiate.

sections.title: The Path of the Shaman
sections.body: Meeting Shikrik begins a shaman's sacred duty to the Horde. She teaches that shamans serve as conduits for ancestral spirits and wielders of elemental wrath. Under her guidance, new shamans learn to channel spiritual energies, mend wounds, and call upon Kalimdor's natural forces.

faq.answer: Gornek gives new shamans in the Valley of Trials a written summons to seek formal instruction from their trainer, Shikrik.
Shikrik, the shaman trainer near the dens in the Valley of Trials, wrote the message and awaits those chosen to guide their people spiritually.

faq.q: Where do I take the parchment?
faq.answer: You take the parchment a short walk away within the Valley of Trials, where Shikrik waits beneath the red crags to train orc and troll shamans.

faq.q: Why was my character chosen to receive it?
faq.answer: Shikrik says those drawn to shamanism are chosen to serve as conduits for the ancestors and speak with the world's elemental forces.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the parchment?
faq.answer: Shikrik accepts you as her student and introduces you to elemental magic, communion with ancestors, and the basics of healing and combat.

faq.q: Can any class complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. The Rune-Inscribed Parchment is for new shamans. Other classes receive distinct summons to their own trainers.

angles.text: As a shaman, this parchment marks your first step on a spiritual path, binding you to the spirits and Durotar's raw elements.
As an orc, your return to shamanism honors Draenor's ancestral traditions, nearly extinguished by the demonic corruption of the Old Horde.
As a Darkspear troll, you bring your natural communion with spirits and reverence for ancestors into the Horde's shared shamanic traditions.
